snippet.title: Pendelum - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on Steam August 19
GET IT HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356380/

Pendelum is a physics-based puzzle platformer with a pendulum that requires patience, skill and creativity.
Use only gravity and external influences to reach the goal, create your own puzzles, compare your performance with others and above all - DON'T RAGE!


0:00 Cinematic Trailer
1:07 Gameplay Footage
